snapshot.title: Write in-universe project briefs for the 6 named contractors
snapshot.description:
The SubcontractorsPanel shows each contractor with name, standing, and mineral preferences. Currently each has a 1-line role but no in-universe project context. Write 2–3 sentences per contractor explaining what they are building, why they need those specific minerals, and what working with them feels like as a player relationship. Output goes into the description field in SubcontractorManager.gd. Kanban: w8f4l5

Contractors (SubcontractorManager.gd):
- SpaceX — Heavy lift launch, buys rare metals at premium
- Rocketlab — Small satellite launch, buys common ores
- Astroforge — In-space smelting, buys Cobalt and Silicates
- Swinburne Automotive — Aerospace components, buys Iron feedstock
- Karman+ — Deep-space mining hardware, buys Platinum
- Skybus Transport — Bulk cargo logistics, buys Nickel and Silicates
